Ram Mandir Donation Theft Probe: Bribery Allegations and Political Accusations Emerge

Ayodhya police have begun investigating allegations of bribery for jobs at the Ram Mandir, with approximately 125 employees reportedly under scrutiny. Investigations are examining appointment letters, service records, and financial transactions. Separately, a lawyer has filed a complaint seeking to name Ram Mandir Trust officials Champat Rai, Anil Mishra, and Gopal Rao in the ongoing donation theft case. Anil Mishra reportedly blamed an individual named 'Tinnu' for lapses, while claiming he himself was not involved. A video showing cash bundles purportedly belonging to the brother of an accused has also surfaced and is part of the investigation. Political parties have also commented, with a BJP MLA issuing a threat against those who steal from the temple, and the Samajwadi Party displaying posters in Kashi.
